title: Auditor Assurance Pack: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Restarts and spares purchases can both be tested from existing records.

sections.heading: Why existing assurance did not catch it

items.text: The findings record no check of purchase records against specifications [FND-0003; EVD-0003].

items.requirement: Every restart after pressure-boundary work has a leak-test record
items.conformity_evidence: A signed test record on each work order
red_flags: Work order closed with no test entry

items.requirement: Critical spares are bought to a specification
items.conformity_evidence: A specification reference on each order
red_flags: Local purchase with no technical approval

items.text: Return-to-service procedure and its revision history
Grade each test point: conforming, partly, not, or not tested.
